reviews.Author: Wemme
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 8, 2024
reviews.Text: Jacobsen Salt is definitely a premium product, and while the bag might be on the smaller side for the price, the quality of the salt is excellent. It’s a bit of a splurge, but so much better than regular table salt. I use it sparingly to make it last, and it elevates everything from salads to grilled meats. If you appreciate artisanal products and don’t mind paying a little extra for quality, Jacobsen Salt is an excellent choice.
reviews.Title: Expensive but worth it

reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 28, 2024
reviews.Text: This is great salt but the company is crap to work with on shipping if u order it on subscription it takes two weeks to get so if u want it every 5 day of the month it actually comes 2 weeks after that
reviews.Title: Company needs to keep this stocked better

reviews.Author: Taylor Paige
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on August 1, 2024
reviews.Text: Use to think all salt was the same. I was wrong! This salt you can tell is great quality. It’s more bold in flavor and you don’t need a whole lot of it. The flakes are kinda big but I can easily crush it up more if I need too. Cooks great and seasons great. The onlllllyyyyyy thing is the bag is pretty small for the price. BUT! like I mentioned you don’t need much of the salt to make the flavors stand out. I am happy with this purchase.
reviews.Title: This salt taste wonderful!
